# ArchiveKind

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Formats` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public enum ArchiveKind
```

Which archive a file holds, as declared by its extension.

## Values

- <span id="f-cookbook"></span>`CookBook = 0` - `.cbk` — an uncooked Set: the container of Recipes.
- <span id="f-recipe"></span>`Recipe = 1` - `.rcp` — a full template for one type.
- <span id="f-ingredient"></span>`Ingredient = 2` - `.igt` — one layer and its weighted variants.
- <span id="f-kitchen"></span>`Kitchen = 3` - `.ktn` — the top-level workspace naming the folder it sits in.
- <span id="f-set"></span>`Set = 4` - `.set` — a cooked Set: generated images plus their metadata, packed.
- <span id="f-sealed"></span>`Sealed = 5` - `.tin` — a sealed export: a whole Set encrypted under a passphrase, marked view-only.
- <span id="f-menu"></span>`Menu = 6` - `.mnu` — a Menu: a CookBook's every weight, rule and colorization plus its art, so an asset can be rolled and rendered at runtime with no `.cbk` present.
